notes: Mower accessory MSRPs and part numbers come only from the Rogue and Revolt build pages (displayed price plus the data-stockcode attribute on each accessory's Select button). The /mowers/accessories, /bandit/accessories and /e-series/accessories pages show no prices or part numbers.

Build-page accessories were merged with /mowers/accessories entries where the build page reuses the same description text (e.g. 'Arm Rest Kit' = 'Steering Arm Pads', 'Weed Trimmer Rack' = 'ROPS String Trimmer Mount', 'Bagger System' = 'Powered 2 & 3 Bagger Systems'); the accessories-page name is kept in 'aliases'. 'Mulch Kit With Blades', 'Bolt On Hitch' and 'Black Vector Wheels' were kept separate from 'Mulching Kit'/'Mulching Blades', 'Tow Hitch' and 'Custom Rims' because the match is not certain.

Variant fits list the build-page engine/deck configurations from each accessory's data-only-available-on attribute (model codes such as BRG6135KA). Accessories with no such restriction are marked '(all configurations on build page)'.

Rogue build page: 'Bolt On Hitch' appears twice with different prices ($59.99 part 093-1128-27 for side-discharge configs; $17.99 part 093-1141-00 for rear-discharge config codes, two of which, BRG61RD35KA and BRG72RD35KA, are not among the page's current engine/deck options). Tweels part numbers differ by line (Rogue 022-4093-00, Revolt 022-4096-00); the build page notes the price is per wheel.
Mower accessories that appear only on /mowers/accessories have group null; that page has no category headings. Bandit and E-Series pages have no categories except the Bandit 'Accessory Kits' block.

Bandit kit components (soft cab enclosure, cab heater, 2" snow blade, plow mount, utility rack, tool holder set, chainsaw holder, gun rack) are stated to be sold individually but have no separate entries or details on the page; they are listed only under each kit's 'includes'.

E-Series 80V battery text says 'Available in 2, 2.5, 4, 5 or 8AH', but the page's size list shows only 2.0/2.5/4.0/5.0 AH; variants follow the list. E-Series 'Shop Now' links go to shop.badboymowers.com and were not followed (outside badboycountry.com).
